messages.subject: integrating telemetry and CMR data
parts:
Maybe a crazy idea but I have been looking in the literature to see if anyone has tried to integrate telemetry and spatially explicit CMR (SCR) data in an open population context.  I have not found much.  I am not talking about using telemetry to estimate the scaling parameter (sigma) for the detection function, but using survival rate (S) and recruitment estimates from telemetry to help with the estimation of phi and f in a Jolly Seber-type model.  I realize that phi includes emigration and S does not, but there are dispersal data embedded in the SCR data too are there not?  Per capita recruitment from telemetry and apparent recruitment (f) from SCR should be similarly (but in reverse) related.  I have long-term CMR and telemetry data on a bear population and it seems a shame not to integrate them in a unified approach for estimating population dynamics.  Thanks for any thoughts. 
Joe
